## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for a user or model.

## Validation

List checks actually run. For visual changes, include original/cleared stills or a render and distinguish source inspection, numerical checks, visual review and listening.

## Provenance and scope

- [ ] New assets are original or have appropriate redistribution rights and notices.
- [ ] No credentials, private logs, personal paths or creator media were added.
- [ ] Relevant guidance and the package manifest were updated.
- [ ] Remaining limitations are stated honestly.
